summary:
Phase 2 AI Feature 3 (Daily Briefing) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passing — auth (401 on GET/DELETE/probe without cookie), probe-with-no-cache returns {briefing:null, cached:false, generated_at:null} in <1.5s (no Claude call), first GET generates via Claude + persists in daily_briefings collection, second GET returns cached:true with identical briefing+generated_at, probe with existing cache returns cached briefing, DELETE clears cache + idempotent, regenerate flow works, briefing mentions real client name 'James Wilson' from pipeline, AI #1 borrower-score + AI #2 lender-match + dashboard stats regression all pass. Frontend: 13/13 Playwright assertions — daily-briefing-section renders above stats grid, briefing-date shows 'Saturday, 23 May 2026' format, teal 4px left border (rgb(14,159,110)) + light grey bg (rgb(249,250,251)), empty state with generate-briefing-btn, loading state with 'Claude is reviewing your pipeline…' italic text + spinner, briefing-content with 5

tags, regenerate-briefing-link visible after generation, cached briefing auto-renders on reload (button hidden), regenerate triggers loading then new content, all existing widgets (stats grid, pipeline overview, commission alerts, quick actions) still render.

issues: Claude's response contains raw markdown headings (e.g. '# Daily Briefing — Saturday, 23 May 2026', '## Pipeline Overview', '## Today's Priorities') which are rendered literally as text including the '#' / '##' characters. Either tighten the prompt to forbid markdown headings (the prompt currently labels sections like 'Today's Priorities' / 'Watch List' but Claude is wrapping them as markdown), or render markdown on the frontend. Cosmetic only — paragraph structure is preserved.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Refine the daily-briefing prompt in /app/backend/routes/ai.py to explicitly instruct Claude NOT to use markdown headings ('#', '##') — currently the section labels render as raw '#' characters in the UI. Or render markdown on the frontend with a lightweight parser.
critical_code_review_comments: Probe path is well-implemented: returns early before any Claude/DB work for active cases. Verified <1.5s response.
Cache key {user_id, date(iso)} is correct and idempotent via update_one upsert. generated_at stored as ISO string.
Graceful degradation: if Claude raises, returns fallback text with active-case + commission counts, still 200. Good.

Date comparison: `clawback_risk_until` query mixes ISO string comparison ($gt today_iso, $lte sixty_days_iso) — works because ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings are lexicographically comparable, but be aware mixed datetime objects in DB could break this. Worth a schema-level note.
ACTIVE_STAGES constant duplicated between backend (ai.py) and frontend (Dashboard.js as `activePipelineStages`). Consider centralising via a shared constants file or an API-provided enum endpoint.

Dashboard.js: useEffect has empty deps — checkCachedBriefing fires once on mount, which is correct. The probe-on-mount pattern means a user opening Dashboard never triggers Claude unintentionally; only the explicit button does. Good UX.

Briefing content render uses split(/\n\n+/) — robust for double-newline splits, but Claude's markdown headers + single newlines produce mixed paragraphs (some short, some with heading prefix). Tied to the markdown-rendering observation above.
seed_data_creation: None — tests use existing admin pipeline (James Wilson active case + TEST_Lender_X). DELETE /api/ai/daily-briefing is invoked at session start and between cache-clear tests to ensure clean state. After test run, a fresh cached briefing is left in daily_briefings collection for today.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_ai_daily_briefing.py covers all daily-briefing scenarios; reuse for regression. The daily_briefings cache for admin user is populated after these tests. Frontend selectors: daily-briefing-section, briefing-date, briefing-empty, generate-briefing-btn, briefing-loading, briefing-content, regenerate-briefing-link. Cache key is {user_id, date.isoformat()}. Probe param ?probe=true skips Claude entirely. NOTE: today's date in this environment is 23 May 2026 (Saturday).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Only a cosmetic recommendation to suppress markdown headings in Claude prompt.
